summary: Phil works steadily at University Music on Telegraph Avenue in Berkeley, advising customers on classical recordings and absorbing the catalog knowledge that he will draw on throughout the fiction; he attends UC Berkeley briefly without completing a term.
source_name: Sutin; Anne R. Dick (The Search, on the record-store milieu)
notes: The University Music period (1948–1951) shapes the Mary and the Giant / In Milton Lumky Territory record-store milieu and PKD's classical-music vocabulary.
